findings.claim: The new module contains the exact `$HOME` and `process.env.HOME` strings that the `no-home-or-tmp-literals` blocking constraint and acceptance scenario require to be absent from `.mjs` files.
findings.evidence: The diff adds comments saying "so `$HOME`, `process.env.HOME` and" in `lib/platform/paths.mjs`, while the acceptance scenario says the blocking constraint `no-home-or-tmp-literals` must find no `$HOME`, `process.env.HOME` or `/tmp/` in any `.mjs` under `lib/`, `scripts/`, `hooks/` or `rules/`; the packet constraint check is `git grep ... -e "[$]HOME|process\.env\.HOME|/tmp/" -- "lib/*.mjs" ...`.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove or rephrase the comment so it does not contain the prohibited literals, rather than weakening the constraint.

findings.claim: The modified blocking check violates the repository command policy by adding a pipe to plain `grep`.
findings.evidence: The diff changes the check to `... | grep -v -E ...`, but the command policy says the project forbids telling an agent to run `grep` and that content checks use `git grep --no-index --exclude-standard`; it also requires commands to behave the same from `cmd.exe`, Windows PowerShell 5.1, bash and zsh.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not pipe to `grep`; keep the portable `git grep`-only check and remove the prohibited literals from source comments instead.
